title: Palaba
tagline: A passion project: my own Roblox game, still under development and not yet deployed.
description: Palaba is a Roblox game I'm designing and scripting myself as a passion project. It's still in development and hasn't been released yet, so there's nothing to play for now. I'm building it in Roblox Studio with Luau while learning more with every update.
role: Solo developer — game design, Luau scripting, level design, UI
highlights: Passion project built solo from scratch
Currently in development — not yet deployed
Learning Luau and Roblox Studio systems as I build
thumbnailAlt: Cover art for Palaba, my Roblox game in development

title: Player One Portfolio
tagline: This site — a retro-game portfolio with scroll storytelling, a 3D hero and hidden easter eggs.
description: A Vite + React single-page portfolio themed as an 8-bit game. Every section is a level, content lives in JSON data files, and heavy effects (Three.js, sound) load only when the device can handle them. Built to stay accessible and fast: keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support and AA contrast in both themes.
highlights: Scroll-driven world map + pixel transitions with GSAP ScrollTrigger
Three.js hero cube that only loads on capable devices (CSS fallback)
Content-driven: projects, certs, skills and timeline are JSON files

title: CustoMate — 3D Product Customization App
tagline: Design custom-printed products on a live 3D model, then order them — all from your phone.
description: A cross-platform mobile app for designing and ordering custom-printed products with a real-time 3D preview. Customers pick a product, drop text and images onto a 3D model (the design wraps onto the mesh instead of floating on top), then check out. A production/QC team fulfils orders through a dedicated staff workflow. Built with React Native (Expo) on a Node/Express + MongoDB API, with a companion web admin dashboard.
role: Mobile developer — 3D customizer, e-commerce flow and staff screens
highlights: Real-time 3D customizer across 7 products (t-shirt, cap, mug, tote bag, jersey, hand fan, mouse pad) with text, images, move/scale/rotate and undo/redo
AI lifestyle preview that turns a design into a product photo, plus AI design generation
Full e-commerce flow: catalog, cart, checkout, order history, GCash / Maya payments via PayMongo
Production & QC workflow with role-based staff screens and proof-photo review
Realtime order and chat updates with Socket.IO, OTP sign-up and push notifications
Known gap: the web admin side of customer chat (inbox and replies) is not built yet
thumbnailAlt: CustoMate app screens: home, 3D customizer and AI lifestyle preview

screenshots.alt: CustoMate home screen with Quick Access shortcuts
3D t-shirt customizer with a color picker
AI design generation panel in the customizer
AI lifestyle preview of a custom green shirt on a model
Payment successful and order summary screen

title: Hotel Reservation System
tagline: Macrotel — guests book rooms on the web or in an app; staff manage reservations from an admin portal.
description: A reservation system with a guest website and staff portal (Next.js on Vercel), a Flutter mobile app and a Supabase database. Guests search rooms with live availability, book with a 15-minute hold, pay at the hotel or online (GCash, Maya, cards via PayMongo), and manage or cancel bookings. Admins see arrivals and departures, record payments, handle walk-ins and moderate reviews. Booking rules are enforced in the database so the web and mobile apps can't get around them.
highlights: Two guests can never book the last room — bookings are processed one at a time
Unpaid bookings release automatically after 15 minutes
English and Filipino, 30 groups of database tests
thumbnailAlt: Home page of the Macrotel hotel reservation website

title: Portfolio with 3 Themes
tagline: A developer portfolio you can switch between three themes: Professional, Minecraft and Roblox.
description: My earlier portfolio, rebuilt around a theme engine. Professional is a calm modern UI; Minecraft recreates the game's interface (title screen with a 3D voxel panorama, hotbar, inventory, advancements, chat); Roblox uses a blocky 3D avatar, a baseplate background and trophy badges. Each theme has light and dark modes and its own section layout. All game art is original and generated in code.
highlights: Three themes, each with its own layout and light/dark mode
Pixel textures and Roblox-style thumbnails generated in code, no official assets
Contact form without a backend (Web3Forms)
thumbnailAlt: Home page of the Portfolio with 3 Themes website

title: Freelancing Website
tagline: A freelance portfolio and services site: browse website styles and app demos, then request a quote.
description: A freelancing site where visitors browse a gallery of website design styles and interactive app demos, read how the work is done, and send an inquiry for a quote. There are no fixed prices — every project is quoted through the contact form. Past clients can leave reviews that appear only after the owner approves them in a small admin area.
highlights: Full-screen demos of website styles and apps
Contact form saves inquiries to Supabase and emails the owner via Resend
Review moderation: reviews go live only after admin approval
Admin area with Supabase Auth
thumbnailAlt: Home page of the Kageza freelancing website

title: Restaurant Website
tagline: Zippies — a fast, modern Italian restaurant website with a menu, reservations and gallery.
description: A fully static restaurant site built with Astro: animated hero, filterable menu (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free), a reservation form with closed-day checks and an add-to-calendar file, events, a gallery lightbox and a contact page. Hours drive a live "open now" badge, SEO structured data and the form validation. Content is edited in JSON files, not code.
highlights: Filterable menu with dietary tags
Reservation form with validation and .ics calendar download
Live "open now" badge driven by one hours file
SEO structured data and sitemap, content editable in JSON
thumbnailAlt: Home page of the Zippies restaurant website

title: Valorant Landing Page
tagline: A Valorant-inspired landing page with agents, maps, ranked and download sections.
description: A single-page, game-style landing page inspired by Valorant: a bold hero with trailer and play buttons, then Agents, Maps, Ranked, Download and News sections, in a dark red-and-black design. Built to practise layout, typography and responsive design with Tailwind.
highlights: Hero, agents, maps, ranked, download and news sections
Responsive dark red-and-black design

title: E-Commerce Website (React)
tagline: ShopEasy — a React online shop with search, product pages, a cart and Cash on Delivery checkout.
description: An e-commerce front end built with React and React Router. Shoppers browse a product catalog with search, category filter and pagination, open product detail pages, manage a cart, and check out with Cash on Delivery, ending on an order-success page.
highlights: Search, category filter and pagination
Product detail pages and shopping cart
Checkout with an order summary and Cash on Delivery
Order success and not-found pages

title: Student Location System
tagline: Campus Compass — register students and pin where they live on an interactive map.
description: A web app for keeping a campus directory of where students live. You register a student (name, course and address), the address is looked up with OpenStreetMap geocoding, and the student appears as a pin on a Leaflet map. Records are saved in the browser, can be deleted, and the app has a light/dark mode.
highlights: Address search turns into map pins (Nominatim / Photon geocoding)
Interactive Leaflet map with a pin per student
Records and theme saved in the browser, light/dark mode
thumbnailAlt: Campus Compass student location map page

title: React Activity Portal
tagline: Five interactive labs for practising React state, events, validation and conditional rendering.
description: A React portal of small practice activities: a Login form with validation, a Password Strength Checker (Weak / Medium / Strong), an Employee Attendance Checker (On Time / Late), an Electricity Bill Calculator with tiered rates, and a Student Grade Evaluator. Each lab shows its result in a clear result panel.
highlights: Five labs: login, password strength, attendance, electricity bill, grade evaluation
Practice with state, events, form validation and conditional rendering
thumbnailAlt: Cover art for the React Activity Portal project
